pie: "ḱludʰí moi, pter werune!"
english: "Hear me, father Werunos!"

pie: tat kukruwants awis agram ā bʰugat.
english: Having heard this, the sheep fled into the plain.

pie: dyéw moy dʰéǵʰom-kʷe wékʷōs ḱlutóm. tā́m h₂yuHénih₂m̥ pótnih₂m̥ h₁áyh₂e. tā́m ne linékʷoh₂. tā́m h₂léksōh₂ tósyeh₂ey-kʷe wr̥ǵyṓh₂ tósyeh₂ey-kʷe sélpos déh₃oh₂. séh₂ ne térseti. tósyeh₂ey gʰórdʰom démōh₂. h₁yód tā́m stunédoh₂ gʰrómos me gʷʰn̥yéh₁s h₁éḱwōs-kʷe moy me mē bʰéroyh₁ent.
english: Sky and Earth, hear my words! I have taken this young woman as wife. I shall not leave her; I shall protect her, and I shall work for her, and I shall give her butter. She shall not become thirsty. I shall build a fence for her. If I strike her, may thunder strike me, and may my horses not carry me.

pie: dyéw ph₂ter dʰéǵʰom méh₂ter-kʷe noh₃ ḱlutóm. wé wiḱpótih₁ tā́m bʰoydʰéh₂m dʰh₁wé tód-kʷe wódr̥ ph₃wé ḱóm-kʷe yungwósdʰh₂. h₁éḱwons toy h₂epó ne h₂éǵōh₂ h₂ówins-kʷe moy h₂epó ne h₂éǵēsi. h₁yós tā́m bʰoydʰéh₂m Hrunépeti gʰrómos tóm gʷʰn̥yéh₁t tósyo-kʷe h₂éǵrōs mē dʰugʰih₁ént. wĺ̥kʷōs tóm gʷr̥h₃óyh₁ent. h₁yós tā́m bʰoydʰéh₂m h₂léksēti só péḱesh₁ h₃pusyéh₁t.
english: Father Sky and Mother Earth, hear us two! We two lords have set this oath, and we two have drunk this water, and we two are joined together. I shall not drive off your horses, and you shall not drive off my sheep. Whoever breaks this oath, may thunder strike him down, and may his fields not be productive. May wolves devour him! Whoever protects this oath, may he increase in wealth!

pie: wíḱpoti lelóykʷth₂e mértis-kʷe te h₁épt. nu nos kʷís h₂lékseti? h₂éh₂usoh₁ nos h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m-kʷe dédeh₃s h₂éǵrons-kʷe nos péh₂s. nu h₃migʰleh₂es sóh₂wl̥ ḱélonti. ḱwoytós néḱt h₁éḱwōs-kʷe toy ne h₁dénti. h₂énǵʰos nos ḱr̥dsú h₁ésti. swépnos nos ne gʷm̥yéti. dʰéyǵʰesi toy sísdomes. memn̥mé te ḱléwos-kʷe toy méǵh₂ h₁ésti.
english: Lord, you are gone, and death seized you. Who now protects us? You used to give us gold and wool, and you guarded our fields. Now clouds cover the sun. The light has vanished, and your horses do not eat. Grief is in our hearts. Sleep does not come to us. We are sitting down by your wall. We remember you, and your fame is great.

pie: wíHre bʰudʰdʰí h₂éǵroy ḱéyth₂er. ne nos ḱléwsesi ḱérh₂sō-kʷe toy stéwdt. HéHḱewes toy h₁éḱwōs Hroth₂óy stesth₂ḗr. h₁léwdʰeros h₁és h₁égʷʰis-kʷe ne bʰéyh₂s. h₁ógʷʰim gʷʰéns gʷṓs-kʷe swóm gʷowsth₂ṓs h₁élh₂s. ḱléwos toy ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₁ésti. méh₂tēr toy h₂énǵʰesh₁ trémti. pótnih₂ toy kʷsépi sédyeti. nu te h₁n̥gʷním bʰéromes. h₁ń̥gʷni tóm wiHróm deywóns wéǵʰe.
english: Hero, wake up; you lie in the field. You do not listen to us, and your head has grown cold. Your swift horses are standing by the chariot. You were free, and you did not grow afraid of the serpent. You slew the serpent, and you drove the cattle to your own cow-stall. Your fame is imperishable. Your mother trembles with grief. Your wife sits in the night. Now we carry you to the Fire. Fire, convey this hero to the gods!

pie: wiḱpótis Hroth₂ṓy kʷetwórn̥s h₁éḱwons yunégt. Hroth₂óm moy h₁áyt nu tóm h₂éǵoh₂. HéHḱewes ḱwónes tóm sékʷontor. wiHrṓs me spéḱyonti h₁eǵ-kʷe tetórph₂e. tóy wérh₁yonti kʷís toy tóm Hroth₂óm déh₃ut? wiḱpótis moy h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr tóm déh₃ut.
english: The lord joined four horses to a chariot. He gave me the chariot; now I drive it. The swift dogs follow it. The men are looking at me, and I am satisfied. They are saying, 'Who gave you this chariot?' The lord, the giver of good things, gave it to me.

pie: h₁eǵ wiḱpóteys stéwtōr h₁ésmi. wĺ̥kʷons térh₂ut térmn̥-kʷe péh₂sti. só memógʰe wĺ̥kʷōs-kʷe tósmōd deduyḗr. pénkʷe moy h₁éḱwons h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m-kʷe déh₃ut. wiHrṓs moy kéh₂nmn̥ kʷsépi ḱl̥nwénti. só ḱlutós bʰúHt ḱlutós-kʷe bʰúHm̥. diwyṓs deywṓs tóm ph₂sté.
english: I am the praiser of the lord. He overcame the wolves, and he guards the boundary. He has power, and the wolves are afraid of him. He gave me five horses and wool. Men listen to my song in the night. He became famous, and I became famous. Heavenly gods, guard him!

pie: tríns moy h₁éḱwons h₁néwn̥ h₂ówins-kʷe déh₃us. kéh₂nmn̥ toy h₂m̥bʰí dédeh₃mi. h₁éyti wétōs m̥rént gʷówes. m̥rént bʰréh₂teres néḱt h₂éh₂usom. h₁wésu ḱléwos ne mért wékʷesu moy h₁ési.
english: You gave me three horses and nine sheep. In exchange I give you a song. Years go, cattle die; brothers die, gold vanishes; good fame does not die: you are in my words.

pie: wiḱpótis kʷsépi mért h₂éweyes-kʷe litént. lówksneh₂ ne léwkt. nu wiHrṓs tóm péh₂wr̥ h₂usési bʰéront. péh₂wr̥ tóm h₁éwset. tósyo tr̥mn̥tíh₂ pótnih₂ h₂énti sédt. tósyo ḱwṓ ne h₁édt. nu wiHrṓs tósyo wérǵeh₂ h₁érkʷont. tósyo h₁nómn̥ kh₂nméni dʰh₁ént. nu dʰéyǵʰos tóm péri démont. wíḱpoti toy h₁nómn̥ ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₁ésti.
english: The lord died in the night, and the birds went away. The moon did not become bright. At dawn the men carried him to the fire. The fire burned him. His wife sat down near, trembling. His dog did not eat. Then the men praised his works. They placed his name in a song. Then they built a wall around him. Lord, your name is imperishable!

pie: dʰúgh₂ter toy póteys dʰéh₁mn̥ gʷh₂dʰí. pótnih₂ h₂én h₁syéh₁s. póteys toy te méh₂tēr swésōr-kʷe wn̥Hih₁tā́m dayh₂wéres-kʷe te wn̥Hih₁ént. h₂usési sth₂dʰí wódr̥-kʷe bʰére péh₂wr̥-kʷe h₂réydʰe. gʷr̥h₂wéni wr̥ǵyé ḱḗr-kʷe toy mē ḱm̥h₂yéh₁t. póteys wérǵom h₁ukdʰí. dayh₂urbʰós mē dedwiyéh₁s. pótis toy wiHrós h₁ésti. h₂yúHenih₂ mē tréms. suHnówōm toy suHnúns widóyh₁s deywṓs-kʷe te ph₂sih₁ént.
english: Daughter, go to your husband's house! May you be mistress there. May your husband's mother and sister come to love you, and may the husband's brothers come to love you. Stand up at dawn, carry water, and make the fire ready. Work at the millstone, and may your heart not grow tired. Learn the husband's work! May you not be afraid of the husband's brothers. Your husband is a hero. Young one, do not tremble! May you see the sons of your sons, and may the gods guard you.

pie: méǵh₂ wíḱpoti swóy dʰh₁méni ḱéyth₂er. h₁yós nos h₁éḱwons dóh₃r̥h₂ dédeh₃s. h₁yós wĺ̥kʷons gʷʰéns h₁yós nos térmn̥ péh₂s. nu te supnós kapyéti. wódr̥ toy gʷʰr̥numés tn̥numés-kʷe te. bʰréh₂teres toy twé péri stesth₂ḗr. swésores toy ḱr̥h₂séni sédyonti. Hroth₂ós toy sth₂éh₁yeti nu kʷís tóm h₂éǵeti? ḱlutóm toy h₁nómn̥ mē n̥ḱyéh₁t.
english: Great lord, you lie in your own house. You who used to give us horses as gifts! You who slew the wolves, you who guarded our boundary! Now sleep grasps you. We are heating water for you, and we are stretching you out. Your brothers stand around you. The sisters sit at your head. Your chariot stands: who now drives it? May your famous name not vanish!

pie: kéh₂nmn̥ moy sth₂dʰí h₁esh₂óm-kʷe gʷh₂dʰí. tósmey h₂usési wr̥h₁dʰí. stéwtōr toy te h₁érkʷeti. tósmey dwóh₁ Hroth₂óh₁ septḿ̥ pórḱons-kʷe déh₃s. só ne tr̥syéti. h₁nómn̥ toy ḱlutóm h₁ésti. h₁esh₂ósyo stóygʰoy mē ḱémh₂s.
english: My song, stand up, and go to the master. Speak to him at dawn: 'Your praiser is praising you. You gave him two chariots and seven piglets. He is not thirsty. Your name is famous.' Do not grow tired on the road to the master!

pie: h₁esh₂óm gʷḗm néweh₂-kʷe wékʷōs wérh₁m̥. nu ph₂wéni sédyonts só ḱléwset. nu só stéh₂t ǵnéh₃t-kʷe me. septḿ̥ moy gʷṓs h₁éḱwom-kʷe h₁áyt. tóns swóm gʷowsth₂óm h₁élh₂m̥ ḱḗr-kʷe moy méwdt. wiḱpóteys ḱléwos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₁syéh₁t.
english: I came to the master, and I spoke new words. Then he, sitting at the fire, was listening. Then he stood up, and he recognized me. He gave me seven cows and a horse. I drove them to my own cow-stall, and my heart became joyful. May the lord's fame be imperishable!

pie: kʷís moy tóns kʷetwórn̥s h₁éḱwons déh₃t? wiḱpótis moy tóns dóh₃r̥h₂ déh₃t. tríns kʷékʷlons h₁opéyom h₂éh₂usoh₁ pl̥nh₁n̥tó. tóns stóygʰoy ǵʰḗm wiHrṓs-kʷe me kʷḱént. tóm h₁érkʷoh₂ h₁yósyo dóh₃r̥h₂ méǵh₂h₂ h₁ésti. gʷíh₃woyh₁t só só-kʷe mē ḱm̥h₂yéh₁t.
english: Who gave me these four horses? The lord gave them to me as gifts. He gave three wagons; they were filled with gold. I drove them on along the road, and the men caught sight of me. I praise him, whose gifts are great. May he live, and may he not grow tired!

pie: wíḱpoti te bʰebʰóydʰh₂e bʰoydʰéh₂m-kʷe moy dʰéh₁m̥. dyḗws dʰéǵʰōm-kʷe ḱléwsetes. sékʷōh₂er te pró-kʷe toy stéh₂oh₂. stóygʰoy ne h₃sléydʰoh₂. dóh₃r̥h₂ toy péh₂soh₂ gʰórdʰoy-kʷe toy bʰebʰéwdʰoh₂. h₁yód te linékʷoh₂ h₁nómn̥ moy n̥ḱyéh₁t ḱwónes-kʷe me h₂éweyes-kʷe gʷr̥h₃óyh₁ent.
english: Lord, I trust you, and I have set my oath. Sky and Earth are listening. I shall follow you, and I shall stand before you. I shall not go astray on the road. I shall guard your gifts, and I shall be alert at your fence. If I leave you, may my name vanish, and may dogs and birds devour me!

pie: póti me linékʷs. dʰh₁méns toy péh₂wr̥ ne dʰégʷʰeti. ḱwṓ toy te h₂isḱéti h₁eǵ-kʷe trésoh₂. suHnúes toy h₂yéwHones h₁sénti. nu kʷís tóns wédʰeti kʷís-kʷe h₂éryēti? h₂óḱets toy dʰéyǵʰesi légʰyeti. kʷíh₁ séngʷs? h₂ówins ph₂sónts túH tr̥méni séngʷs. h₂éǵros toy h₁sh₂énh₁ h₁rudʰéh₁ti. wiHrṓs toy h₁wésu ḱléwos ḱl̥wih₁ént. h₂ew ne snéwbʰōh₂. póti te memónh₂e.
english: Husband, you left me. The fire of your house does not burn. Your dog is seeking you, and I tremble in fear. Your sons are young. Who now leads them, and who will plough? Your harrow lies by the wall. How did you fall? You, guarding the sheep, fell at the boundary. The field is red with your blood. May men hear your good fame. I shall not marry again. Husband, I remember you.

pie: (h₁)éḱwōs ewewkʷ, "ḱludʰí, h₂ówi! ḱḗrd h₂gʰnutoy widntbʰós: dʰǵʰémō(n), pótis, h₂wlnéh₂m h₂ówyom kʷnewti sébʰoy gʷʰérmom wéstrom; h₂éwibʰoskʷe h₂wlh₂néh₂ né h₁esti."
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: wiḱpótis moy dóh₃r̥h₂ h₂usú wéǵʰeti. kéh₂nmn̥ moy dʰǵʰyés ḱléwt tósyo-kʷe ḱḗr méwdt. nu moy swéḱs gʷṓs h₁néwn̥ h₂ówins-kʷe déh₃ut. tóybʰos gʷowsth₂óm démont. h₁eǵ wékʷesōm wéydtōr h₁ésmi. só me wóyde tóm-kʷe wóydh₂e. nu moy h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm h₁ésti. tósyo ḱléwos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₁ésti.
english: At the dawns the lord conveys gifts to me. Yesterday he heard my song, and his heart became joyful. Then he gave me six cows and nine sheep. He built a cow-stall for them. I am one who knows the words. He knows me, and I know him. Now my name is famous. His fame is imperishable.

pie: dwóh₁ moy bʰréh₂terh₁ dóh₃r̥h₂ duh₃tā́m. déḱm̥t h₁éḱwons kʷetwórn̥s kʷékʷlons-kʷe h₁áytām. h₁éḱwōs HéHḱewes h₁sénti. kʷékʷlōs h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m wéǵʰonti. tóysōm dóh₃r̥h₂ méǵh₂h₂ h₁ésti. bʰóh₁ tóysōm swésorn̥s-kʷe h₁érkʷoh₂. tóysōm ḱléwos tetn̥yéh₁t.
english: The two brothers gave me gifts: they gave ten horses and four wagons. The horses are swift. The wagons carry wool. Their gifts are great. I praise both of them and their sisters. May their fame be stretched out!

pie: deywṓs wiḱpóteyey péḱos duh₃ént. só moy tód dédeh₃ti. tríns h₁éḱwons h₁néwn̥ gʷṓs gʷowsth₂óm-kʷe h₁opéyet. tósmey néwom kéh₂nmn̥ tḗtḱmi. h₁eǵ tósyo stéwtōr h₁ésmi. wékʷōs moy tósmey suh₂dyéh₁t. h₁ń̥gʷni moy wékʷōs ḱléwse. gʷíh₃woyh₁t só só-kʷe mē ḱm̥h₂yéh₁t.
english: The gods gave wealth to the lord. He gives it to me. He gave three horses, nine cows and a cow-stall. I am fashioning a new song for him. I am his praiser. May my words become sweet to him! Fire, listen to my words! May he live, and may he not grow tired!

pie: dʰúgh₂ter toy méh₂term̥ linékʷsi. swóh₁ pótih₁ gʷh₂dʰí. pótis toy te wéǵʰeti. dʰúgh₂ter h₂uHsó. stóygʰōd mē bʰéyh₂s. stóygʰos toy h₁itós h₁syéh₁t dayh₂wéres-kʷe te dukih₁ént. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m wéso h₁yéh₂m toy déh₃m̥ memn̥dʰí-kʷe me meménoh₂-kʷe te. h₂éwsōs toy diwés dʰugh₂tḗr h₂usyéh₁t ḱḗr-kʷe toy mudyéh₁t.
english: Daughter, you are leaving your mother. Go with your own husband! Your husband is conveying you. Daughter, put on footwear! Do not be afraid of the road! May the road be passable for you, and may the husband's brothers lead you. Wear the wool which I gave you, and remember me, and I shall remember you! May Dawn, the daughter of Sky, become bright for you, and may your heart become joyful.

pie: tód sélpos ph₂wéni tinéh₁ti. h₁yós tā́m bʰoydʰéh₂m Hrunépeti só tinh₁yéh₁t. séh₂ h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂ ph₂wéni h₁éwsetor. h₁yós tā́m bʰoydʰéh₂m Hrunépeti tósyo dʰéh₁mn̥ h₁éwsoyto. tód wódr̥ yéseti. h₁yós tā́m bʰoydʰéh₂m Hrunépeti tósyo h₁ésh₂r̥ yésoyh₁t. sóh₂wl̥ tóm dedórḱe dyḗws-kʷe tóm ḱléwseti.
english: This fat is melting in the fire. Whoever breaks this oath, may he melt! This wool is burning in the fire. Whoever breaks this oath, may his house burn! This water is boiling. Whoever breaks this oath, may his blood boil! The sun sees him, and Sky is listening to him.

pie: súHnu moy kúdʰe h₁ési? ní ḱéyth₂er kʷséps-kʷe te ḱéleti. h₂énts toy stéwdt h₂yéwHō-kʷe h₁és. h₂élom te bʰoréyom-kʷe te. upó bʰuHyés wiHrós-kʷe ne bʰúHs. kʷís te h₁épt? mértis te kʷsépi h₁épt. dʰéǵʰom méh₂ter tóm ph₂sdʰí.
english: My son, where are you? You are lying down, and the night covers you. Your forehead has grown cold, and you were young. I nourished you, and I used to carry you around. You were growing up, and you did not become a man. Who seized you? Death seized you in the night. Mother Earth, guard him!

pie: lelóykʷe méǵh₂s wiḱpótis. lelóykʷe h₂éh₂usosyo déh₃tōr. lelóykʷe h₁éḱwōm h₁esh₂ós. wíḱpoti nos sóh₂wl̥ h₁és ní séngʷs nu kʷséps gʷémt. méǵʰye stutréy déḱm̥t márkons h₁opéyes. nu moy kʷís dóh₃r̥h₂ dédeh₃ti? kʷís moy wékʷōs ḱl̥néwti? néwom toy kéh₂nmn̥ tḗtḱmi. tód te deywóns bʰéreti.
english: Gone is the great lord; gone is the giver of gold; gone is the master of the horses. Lord, you were our sun; you sank down; now the night has come. You gave me, the praiser, ten horses. Now who gives me gifts? Who listens to my words? I am fashioning a new song for you. It carries you to the gods.

pie: tóm méǵh₂m̥ wiHróm h₁érkʷōmes. só gʷṓs wĺ̥kʷoybʰos spért mr̥téys-kʷe ne bʰéyh₂t. tósyo ḱḗr stéwdt tósyo-kʷe ḱwṓ ḱóm légʰyeti. tóm tl̥néh₂omes tóm-kʷe ní logʰéyōmes. h₂éh₂usom tósyo ḱr̥h₂séni dʰéh₁omes. tósyo wérǵeh₂ meménomes. wíHre ph₂trṓm stóygʰoy gʷh₂dʰí. dwóh₁ ḱwónh₁ dʰgʷʰh₂dʰí ph₂téres-kʷe te h₁áyih₁ro.
english: Let us praise this great hero. He rescued the cattle from the wolves, and he did not grow afraid of death. His heart has grown cold, and his dog lies down close by. Let us lift him, and let us lay him down. Let us place gold at his head. Let us remember his works. Hero, go on the path of the fathers! Pass by the two dogs, and may the fathers receive you.

pie: h₂yéwHō pótis kʷékʷlōy dwóh₁ HéHḱuh₁ h₁éḱwoh₁ yunégt h₂yuHn̥yéh₂s-kʷe dʰéh₁mn̥ h₁élh₂t. néweh₂m h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m wésm̥h₁neh₂ séh₂ dʰéyǵʰesi sth₂éh₁yet. tósyeh₂s bʰréh₂tēr tā́m h₁éǵʰs wédʰet tā́m-kʷe kʷékʷloy sodéyet. nu pótis tóh₁ h₂epó h₂éǵet dayh₂wéres-kʷe tā́m sékʷonto. stóygʰos h₁itós h₁ést tóy-kʷe ne h₃slidʰént. h₂éwis gʰórdʰoy sédt séh₂-kʷe séh₂gyet. póteys swésōr tā́m ph₂wéni h₁áyto. h₂yéwHones wiHrṓs píph₃ont tóy-kʷe mudént. dayh₂wéres pórḱom pékʷont. deywṓs tóybʰos h₁wésuh₂ dh₃ih₁ént.
english: The young husband joined two swift horses to the wagon and drove to the young woman's house. She, wearing new wool, was standing by the wall. Her brother led her out and seated her on the wagon. Then the husband drove them away, and the husband's brothers followed her. The road was passable, and they did not go astray. A bird sat down on the fence, and it gave a sign. The husband's sister received her at the fire. The young men were drinking, and they became joyful. The husband's brothers cooked a piglet. May the gods give them good things!

pie: ph₂tḗr póteyey swéh₂m dʰugh₂térm̥ dʰǵʰyés h₁opéyet pótis-kʷe h₁wédmn̥ kʷetwórn̥s h₁éḱwons kʷékʷlom-kʷe h₁áyt. tósyeh₂s méh₂tēr tā́m néweh₂h₁ h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂h₁ woséyet tósyeh₂s-kʷe swésōr pḱténm̥ tósyeh₂s ḱr̥h₂séni dʰéh₁t. nu pótis tā́m tósyeh₂s dʰh₁méns wédʰet dwóh₁-kʷe tósyeh₂s bʰréh₂terh₁ énu stéygʰetām. nu póteys gʰórdʰom h₁ludʰónt. pótis tā́m h₁n̥gʷním trís péri wédʰet dayh₂wḗr-kʷe tā́m h₁n̥gʷnéy sodéyet. dayh₂wéres tā́m spéḱyont tóy-kʷe dʰm̥bʰént. nu pótis wérh₁t. h₁eǵ dyḗws h₁ésmi túH dʰéǵʰōm h₁ési. nu gʷréh₂wonm̥ stéygʰet. h₁ń̥gʷni tā́m pótnih₂m̥ ph₂sdʰí. suHnúes dʰugh₂téres-kʷe tósyeh₂ey ǵeǵn̥h₁ih₁ént pótih₁-kʷe gʷíh₃woyh₁t. mértis tā́m mē h₂eh₂n̥ḱyéh₁t.
english: Yesterday the father gave his own daughter to the husband, and the husband gave the bride price: four horses and a wagon. Her mother clothed her in new wool, and her sister placed a comb on her head. Then the husband led her from her house, and her two brothers walked after. Then they arrived at the husband's fence. Three times the husband led her around the Fire, and the husband's brother seated her by the Fire. The husband's brothers were looking at her, and they became astonished. Then the husband spoke: 'I am Sky; you are Earth.' Then she climbed onto the millstone. Fire, guard this wife! May sons and daughters be born to her, and may she live with the husband. May death not reach her.
